commitResults.messageTitle: Expose complete test failures in CI
commitResults.messageBody: Bootstrap assertions include child-process output, but abbreviated CI logs hid that diagnostic text. Retain full exception messages so hosted-runtime failures can be investigated without skipping acceptance checks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Resolve bootstrap folder aliases in assertions
commitResults.messageBody:
Windows CI launches child JVMs under the RUNNER~1 short-path alias,
while production resolves application home to runneradmin. Comparing
their path spellings fails despite correctly selected operational data.

Resolve the probe's working directory to its real path before deriving
the expected data path. Keep exact data-path, recovery, preservation and
preference assertions, including the missing-file case.

The consolidated guide attributed command dispatch to the catalogue,
which only defines available command words and guidance.

Describe CanonicalPeopleSession.execute() as the dispatcher in the
runtime summary, Logic design and session section. Retain the parser,
executor and save-before-publication boundaries described by the code.
